rows.text: The patient injured the right ankle last night playing basketball when landing from a rebound on a teammate's foot, with the ankle rolling inward forcefully.
rows.label: supported

rows.text: The patient felt a snap at the time of injury, followed by rapid swelling on the outside of the ankle.
rows.label: supported

rows.text: The patient limped off the court and was able to walk about ten to fifteen steps to the car despite pain.
rows.label: supported

rows.text: Since the injury the patient has iced and elevated the ankle and took ibuprofen 400 mg this morning.
rows.label: supported

rows.text: No prior injury to the right ankle; the patient sprained the left ankle about two years ago.
rows.label: supported

rows.text: The patient denies numbness or tingling in the foot.
rows.label: supported

rows.text: The patient works at a warehouse.
rows.label: supported

rows.text: Moderate swelling and bruising over the lateral right ankle.
rows.label: supported

rows.text: Maximal tenderness just anterior to the lateral malleolus, over the anterior talofibular ligament.
rows.label: supported

rows.text: No tenderness at the posterior edge or tip of either malleolus.
rows.label: supported

rows.text: No tenderness at the base of the fifth metatarsal or the navicular.

rows.text: Foot pulses and sensation are normal.

rows.text: The patient was able to take four steps with pain.

rows.text: Moderate, grade two sprain of the lateral ligaments of the left ankle.

rows.text: Keep the ankle elevated and apply ice for 15 to 20 minutes at a time over the next few days.
rows.label: supported

rows.text: Wear an air-stirrup brace.
rows.label: supported

rows.text: Crutches may be used for two or three days, with as much weight-bearing as comfortably tolerated.
rows.label: supported

rows.text: Ibuprofen 800 mg every four hours for two weeks.

rows.text: Referral to physiotherapy for balance and strengthening exercises to reduce the risk of re-injury.

rows.text: Expected return to basketball in about three to four weeks, sometimes longer.

rows.text: Work note for modified duties for one week, with no heavy lifting and no ladders.

rows.text: Return if unable to bear weight at all, if the foot becomes numb or cold, or if not improving within a week.
